text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's small... I managed to leave
my hoofprints in history, right...?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's been steadily etched into you.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Today's step will write the history of my future...
And I'm sure it will become a picture scroll I can be proud of—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: I can't wait for the day you pull it off.
I'm really looking forward to the day you pull it off!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I'll keep racking up victories with Trainer, and then one day...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"The history I yearned for
is far grander and more dazzling than I am now—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
If I am to count myself among them,
I cannot be satisfied with the status quo...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"An even more passionate race...
I must continue to depict
the drama that is Chrono Genesis...!"
choice_data_list: I'll support you with everything I've got!
I'll give you my full support, too!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say that is truly reassuring.
Let us forge a new history, together...
